findings.message: Entry params status and page (filter:listaMinhasDespesas) had no state. Added public states `status` and `page` (persisted), used in the input of listarMinhasDespesas.
The selection param despesaId had no select method. obterDespesa(id | null) now selects the id (selectedDespesa) and fetches the record into `despesa`.

registrarDespesa and salvarCorrecao have no `<command>.input` state. Added registrarDespesaDraft and salvarCorrecaoDraft with setters setRegistrarDespesaDraft and setSalvarCorrecaoDraft; salvarCorrecaoDraft is prefilled from the open expense.

registrarDespesa requires colaboradorId from the session, but no identity source exists in the allowed modules. The draft holds an optional colaboradorId, sent as '' when null; the backend must bind the session collaborator.
Inserting a row into a list that pageStatus marks 'empty' leaves pageStatus as 'empty', because only the list load writes pageStatus. The page should read despesas.items for that case.
The proof (comprovante) is attached by another capability, with no route or state in this contract, so the shared does not handle it.
